{{Quote|Ord Mantell is fighting a civil war against violent separatists funded and trained by the Empire.|[[Satele Shan]]|<ref name="Cademimu" />}}
The '''Separatist War''' was a civil conflict that occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In the aftermath of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] and the end of the [[Great Galactic War]], the corrupt government of Ord Mantell decided to remain loyal to the Republic, and the rise of a [[Mantellian Separatist Movement|separatist movement]] among the people soon broke out into open conflict.

==Prelude==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] was settled by [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] colonists around [[12,000 BBY/Legends|12,000 BBY]], and it was utilized as a [[Ordnance/Regional Depot/Legends|Ordnance/Regional Depot]] for the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military's]] operations in the northern [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. However, despite becoming a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Ord Mantell gradually lost its strategic value<ref name="Holonet" /> after new [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] eliminated the need for Republic fleets to pass through the [[Bright Jewel Cluster/Legends|Bright Jewel Cluster]]. Military engineers and their families were transferred to other planets, leaving the population mostly farmers.<ref name="Underworld Influences">{{TORcite|type=codex|Underworld Influences}}</ref> After a [[Unidentified Republic admiral|corrupt admiral]] sold off the local fleet, the Republic Military abandoned its interests on the planet entirely, and Ord Mantell became known as a haven for [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], and [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]].<ref name="Holonet" /> While Ord Mantell's numerous ports continued to attract traders and merchants, the black market began to thrive and the planetary government fell under the control of various crime syndicates.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Ord Mantell}}</ref> Corporations and underworld figures took control of the now-abandoned military spaceports, and political corruption remained rampant over the following centuries.<ref name="Underworld Influences" /> While ordinary Mantellians viewed their government with disdain, some more radical fringe groups actively protested the corruption. When an entire governmental cabinet was forced to step down after it was revealed they accepted bribes, the fringe groups began to gain support and gradually developed into a cohesive movement.<ref name="Ruled by Corruption">{{TORcite|type=codex|Ruled by Corruption}}</ref>

==The conflict==
[[File:Separatist_War_Space.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A space battle during the Separatist War]]
The civil war was fought both on the surface of Ord Mantell, notably on the island of [[Avilatan]], and in space, where ships affiliated with the Mantellian Separatist Movement clashed with the Republic's fleet. Many civilians were killed during the conflict.<ref name="Codex" />
